name: Starry☆Sky ~After Winter~
source: Starry Sky After Winter continues from the events of the previous game, with Tsukiko studying in Seigetsu Academy for the third year. It follows the continuations of the routes from Starry Sky in Winter and there is a new route for Kagurazaka Shiki.
translation: 《Starry☆Sky～After Winter～》承接前作剧情，夜久月子正在星月学园读三年级。本作讲述《Starry☆Sky～in Winter～》各条路线的后续，并为神乐坂四季新增了一条路线。
